name: job application email
script:
# Job Applicant Acknowledgment Email Script # Trigger: After Insert on Job Applicant DocType recipient_email = doc.get("email_id") if recipient_email: # Applicant Details applicant_name = doc.get("applicant_name") or "Candidate" job_opening = doc.get("job_title") or "Not specified" designation = doc.get("designation") or "Not specified" status = doc.get("status") or "Under Review" phone = doc.get("phone_number") or "Not provided" country = doc.get("country") or "Not provided" # Company logo site_url = frappe.utils.get_url() logo_url = site_url + "/files/company_logo.png" # Replace with your logo path # Email Subject subject = f"Thank You for Applying - Ref: {doc.name}" # Email Body message = f"""

Thank You for Your Application!

Dear {applicant_name},

Thank you for applying for the position of {designation} (Job Opening: {job_opening}). We have received your application and our recruitment team will review your profile shortly.

Your Application Details:

Reference Number: {doc.name}

Email: {recipient_email}

Phone: {phone}

Country: {country}

Status: {status}

What Happens Next?

  • Our HR team will review your application
  • If shortlisted, you will be contacted for the next round
  • You can track your application status through our portal

If you have any questions, feel free to reach us at hr@yourcompany.com.

Best regards,
Your Recruitment Team

""" # Send Email frappe.sendmail( recipients=[recipient_email], subject=subject, message=message ) # Add comment on Job Applicant doc.add_comment("Comment", f"Acknowledgment email sent to {recipient_email}") else: frappe.log_error(f"No email found for Job Applicant: {doc.name}", "Email Missing")

name: interview creation email
script:
# Interview Acknowledgment Email Script # Trigger: After Insert on Interview DocType # Get Job Applicant job_applicant = doc.get("job_applicant") if job_applicant: applicant_doc = frappe.get_doc("Job Applicant", job_applicant) recipient_email = applicant_doc.get("email_id") if recipient_email: # Applicant & Job Info applicant_name = applicant_doc.get("applicant_name") or "Candidate" job_opening = doc.get("job_opening") or "Not specified" designation = doc.get("designation") or "Not specified" interview_round = doc.get("interview_round") or "Not specified" interview_date = doc.get("scheduled_on") or "To be scheduled" from_time = doc.get("from_time") or "-" to_time = doc.get("to_time") or "-" status = doc.get("status") or "Pending" # Company Logo site_url = frappe.utils.get_url() logo_url = site_url + "/files/company_logo.png" # Replace with your logo path # Email Subject subject = f"Interview Scheduled - {designation} ({job_opening})" # Email Body message = f"""

Interview Scheduled

Dear {applicant_name},

We are pleased to inform you that your interview has been scheduled for the role of {designation} under Job Opening {job_opening}.

Interview Details:

Interview Round: {interview_round}

Date: {interview_date}

Time: {from_time} - {to_time}

Status: {status}

Reference ID: {doc.name}

Please ensure you are available at the scheduled time. If you need to reschedule, kindly reply to this email at hr@yourcompany.com.

We look forward to meeting you.

Best regards,
Your Recruitment Team

""" # Send Email frappe.sendmail( recipients=[recipient_email], subject=subject, message=message ) # Add comment on Interview doc.add_comment("Comment", f"Interview email sent to {recipient_email}") else: frappe.log_error(f"No email found for Job Applicant: {job_applicant}", "Interview Email Missing") else: frappe.log_error(f"No Job Applicant linked in Interview: {doc.name}", "Interview Email Missing")
